decisions.statement: Deliver all named subsystems in one resumable phase with internal slices.
Require exact owner approval for Git closeout mutations.
Auto-install safe pinned official user-space providers and otherwise provide the official manual path.
Install the qualified selected skill set completely across detected hosts.
decisions.rationale: Prevent host parity drift without blind imports.

decisions.statement: Use pragmatic claim-complete verification and real UI/device flows when they best prove behavior.
decisions.rationale: Catch actual behavior with bounded cost.

decisions.statement: Represent the control loop with typed runtime contracts and evidence, not prose alone.
Add semantic workflow validation for the high-impact rule and skill graph.
decisions.rationale: Structural validation does not catch cross-file policy contradictions.

decisions.statement: Require explicit expiry and retirement evidence for model-specific workarounds.
Generate OpenCode /goal as an emulated custom command in S1; use the bootstrap prompt beforehand.
decisions.rationale: OpenCode has custom commands but no Codex-native durable goal.

decisions.statement: Keep the Pencil-led Dockerized Control Plane rebuild as the successor phase.
decisions.rationale: Build the UI against stable post-patch contracts.

decisions.statement: Make Control Plane V2 the final phase after complete skill/provider/tool/MCP/host/runtime parity, terminal proof, CI, installation receipts, and owner-approved harness closeout.
decisions.rationale: The final UI must consume the fully completed harness.

decisions.statement: Supersede mandatory /goal entry with prompt-first execution: ordinary conversation is sufficient, while slash commands are optional host ergonomics compiled into the same WorkRequest.
decisions.rationale: Portable semantics must not depend on uneven host command features.

decisions.statement: Treat post-plan review findings as typed pair-repair input that selectively reopens affected claims and requires fresh proof without rewriting historical PASS evidence.
decisions.rationale: Long plans need safe conversational repair after review without restarting or corrupting history.

tasks.objective: Unify the plan/support-pack contract and compile ordinary conversation, optional slash commands, CLI/API calls, and native host actions into the same canonical WorkRequest.
tasks.rollback: Keep v1 readers and disable the new goal entrypoint without deleting compiled artifacts.

tasks.objective: Implement immutable external source governance and selected-skill parity.
tasks.rollback: Retain new sources as catalog-only and disable external materialization.

tasks.objective: Implement provider-neutral adapters for all named verification capabilities.
evidence_requirements: one positive, negative, and unavailable fixture per provider
tasks.rollback: Disable new provider IDs and retain existing provider behavior.

constraints: provider activation is fact and claim driven

tasks.objective: Implement seven-host inventory, projection, parity, transactional repair, and installed-only synchronization.
tasks.rollback: Keep the transactional v1 installer and expose new reconciliation in report-only mode.

constraints: config directory alone is not installation proof

tasks.objective: Migrate and complete foreground browser, mobile, and Pencil behavior.
tasks.rollback: Restore Pencil to explicit manual-only projection while retaining foreground browser policy.

constraints: headless only under explicit CI profile

tasks.objective: Implement typed closed-loop routing, evidence sensing, convergence clamps, failure-to-eval feedback, and claim verification from deterministic facts, impact, claim class, and risk.
tasks.rollback: Return Decision Fabric to shadow mode while retaining diagnostic facts.

constraints: prompt keywords alone cannot activate heavy providers

tasks.objective: Converge pointer-driven lifecycle, evidence-preserving compaction, and bounded CI.
tasks.rollback: Restore historical phase validators as compatibility gates and keep compaction dry-run only.

tasks.objective: Converge the high-impact rule and skill graph semantically across lifecycle, planning, completion, context, delegation, research, QA, quality, and UI precedence.
tasks.rollback: Revert only semantic-policy changes that fail the contradiction corpus while retaining audit evidence and structural validators.

tasks.objective: Implement prompt-first conversational pair repair with finding classification, claim-impact analysis, selective reopen, bounded repair packets, and fresh evidence epochs.
tasks.rollback: Disable pair-repair mutation while retaining report-only classification and impact analysis.

tasks.objective: Integrate, activate by CAS, dogfood, reinstall detected hosts, verify hosted CI, prepare owner-gated closeout, and emit Control Plane V2 only as the final eligible phase.
